lore.supplementaries.key: A key that locks Safes, Infernite Doors and Trapdoors, and Lock Blocks. Rename it to set its password.
lore.supplementaries.cog_block: A solid block that carries Flux Power through itself like dust, in any direction.
lore.supplementaries.redstone_illuminato: A lamp that is brightest when unpowered and dims as its Flux signal gets stronger.
lore.supplementaries.lock_block: A block that can be locked with a Key, and gives a Flux signal when used with the matching Key.
lore.supplementaries.wind_vane: A weather vane that sways in the wind, swinging harder in rain and storms. It gives off a Flux signal as it swings.
lore.supplementaries.bellows: A block that blows air when powered or stood on. It pushes entities, fans fires, speeds up Furnaces in front of it, and hastens Copper oxidation.
lore.supplementaries.jar: A glass jar that can hold liquids, Cookies, small critters, and fish. Liquids inside can be drunk straight from it.
lore.supplementaries.pulley_block: A block that winds Rope or Chain up and down when turned by a Crank or Turn Table, lifting whatever is attached to the end. Pulleys can be chained together.
lore.supplementaries.item_shelf: A small wooden shelf that displays a single item.
lore.supplementaries.safe: A secure storage block that keeps its items when broken. It belongs to whoever first opens it, or can be locked with a Key.
lore.supplementaries.globe: A spinning globe showing the world around you. A rare find in shipwrecks.
lore.supplementaries.globe_sepia: An antique globe, washed with Antique Ink. A rare find in shipwrecks.
lore.supplementaries.speaker_block: A block that broadcasts a message to players nearby when powered. Rename it to change who the message is from.
lore.supplementaries.soap: A bar of soap that washes things clean: it removes dye from items, scrapes a level of oxidation off Copper, cleans pets and Sheep, and wipes Blackboards and Maps.
lore.supplementaries.soap_block: A slippery block of Soap. Things slide across it like ice.
lore.supplementaries.sack: A 9-slot bag that keeps its items when broken. Carrying more than two slows you down.
lore.supplementaries.gravel_bricks: Bricks of packed gravel that crumble when jumped or fallen on.
lore.supplementaries.suspicious_gravel_b: Gravel Bricks with something buried inside. Brush it to uncover it.
lore.supplementaries.ash: The remains of burnt wood. Washed away by rain, and used to make Soap.
lore.supplementaries.fine_wood: Wood treated with Beeswax to give it a fine, polished finish.
lore.supplementaries.barnacles: Barnacles that grow on stone along the shore.
lore.supplementaries.stone_lamp: A carved stone lamp that gives off bright light.
lore.supplementaries.blackstone_lamp: A carved blackstone lamp that gives off bright light.
lore.supplementaries.deepslate_lamp: A carved deepslate lamp that gives off bright light.
lore.supplementaries.end_stone_lamp: A carved Esoterrock lamp that gives off bright light.
lore.supplementaries.sconce_glow: A wall-mounted torch that burns with a Glowlight flame.
lore.supplementaries.pignata: A party piñata shaped like a pig. Break it open for treats!
lore.supplementaries.dispenser_minecart: A Minecart carrying a Dispenser. It fires its contents when it passes over a powered Activator Rail.
lore.supplementaries.lunch_basket: A wicker basket that holds food you can eat straight from it.
lore.supplementaries.urn: A clay urn found underground that holds all sorts of loot. Looting improves what spills out.
lore.supplementaries.trapped_present: A gift box that springs a trap on whoever opens it.
lore.supplementaries.present: A gift box that can be filled and addressed to another player with a message.
lore.supplementaries.wrench: A tool that rotates any rotatable block. Sneak to rotate the other way.
lore.supplementaries.slingshot: A slingshot that fires blocks, placing them where they land. It pulls ammo from the left side of your hotbar first.
lore.supplementaries.rope_arrow: An arrow wound with Rope. Where it hits, it unrolls the rope down from the impact point. Refill it with Rope.
lore.supplementaries.quiver: A quiver that holds several kinds of Arrows and lets you swap between them. Sometimes dropped by Skeletons.
lore.supplementaries.cannon: A cannon that fires whatever you load into it. Blocks are placed where they land, and projectiles fly as projectiles. Uses Gunpowder as fuel.
lore.supplementaries.cannonball: A heavy ball for Cannons that breaks blocks on impact and bounces off surfaces.
lore.supplementaries.blackboard: A board that can be drawn on with dye, chalk, coal, quartz, or glow ink. Wipe it clean with Soap.
lore.supplementaries.notice_board: A board that displays a Written Book, Map, or Banner Pattern for anyone to read.
lore.supplementaries.clock_block: A block that displays the current time. Use it to read the exact time.
lore.supplementaries.goblet: A cup that can hold a liquid, making it easy to drink.
lore.supplementaries.hourglass: An hourglass that can be filled with sand, dusts, slime, or honey, each falling at a different speed. Gives off a Flux signal as it runs.
lore.supplementaries.cage: A cage that can trap small mobs. Sneak-use to place it with the mob inside.
lore.supplementaries.flower_box: A box that holds flowers, including tall ones. Can be placed on floors, walls, and ceilings.
lore.supplementaries.planter: A pot that lets plants and crops grow without water.
lore.supplementaries.hat_stand: A stand that displays a helmet or hat. Give it a poke to make it wobble!
lore.supplementaries.statue: A statue that can hold an item in its hand. Some items make it do something fun when powered.
lore.supplementaries.timber_frame: A timber frame that can be filled with any full block.
lore.supplementaries.doormat: A mat that can display text. A favourite spot for Cats.
lore.supplementaries.feather_block: A fluffy block that cancels all fall damage.
lore.supplementaries.sugar_cube: A block of Sugar that dissolves in rain or water.
lore.supplementaries.bamboo_spikes: Spikes that slow and hurt creatures walking into them, more so when pushed onto them. Coat them with a Lingering Potion to add its effect.
lore.supplementaries.bamboo_spikes_tippe: Bamboo Spikes coated with a potion. They slow, hurt, and afflict creatures with the potion's effect.
lore.supplementaries.sconce_lever: A wall torch that doubles as a lever.
lore.supplementaries.turn_table: A block that rotates the block or entity on top of it when powered. Use it to reverse its direction.
lore.supplementaries.spring_launcher: A spring-loaded piston that launches entities into the air.
lore.supplementaries.faucet: A tap that drains liquids from blocks behind it into containers below. Toggle it by hand or with Flux Power.
lore.supplementaries.relayer: A block that passes the Flux signal it receives out the back at full strength.
lore.supplementaries.crystal_display: A display that shows a number or symbol based on its Flux signal strength.
lore.supplementaries.slidy_block: A block that slides along the ground when pushed. It slides further on ice and soap.
lore.supplementaries.lumisene_bucket: A bucket of Lumisene, a thin, glowing, flammable liquid.
lore.supplementaries.lumisene_bottle: A bottle of Lumisene. Drinking it makes you glow, but also makes you catch fire more easily.
lore.supplementaries.fire_pit: A fire pit that burns with the potency of Lumisene.
lore.supplementaries.antique_ink: A sepia ink that makes Signs, Maps, Books, and Globes look aged. Wash it off with Soap.
lore.supplementaries.slice_map: A map that shows the world at the height it was made, instead of the surface.
lore.supplementaries.confetti_popper: A party popper that bursts into confetti. It can be worn on your head.
lore.supplementaries.pancake: A stack of pancakes that can be topped with Honey, Chocolate, or Syrup.
lore.supplementaries.candy: A sweet that's best eaten in moderation.
lore.supplementaries.sconce_soul: A wall-mounted torch that burns with Soul Fire.
lore.supplementaries.sconce_green: A wall-mounted torch that burns with a Cupric flame.
lore.supplementaries.sconce_nether_brass: A wall-mounted torch that burns with a Nether Brass flame.
lore.supplementaries.daub: A wall of hardened straw and clay.
lore.supplementaries.daub_frame: A wall of hardened straw and clay, framed with sticks.
lore.supplementaries.raked_gravel: Gravel raked with a Hoe into patterns that curve to connect.
lore.supplementaries.iron_gate: A sturdy fence gate that stacks into taller gates.
lore.supplementaries.gold_gate: A fancy fence gate that stacks into taller gates.
lore.supplementaries.gold_door: A fancy door that locks shut while powered.
lore.supplementaries.gold_trapdoor: A fancy trapdoor that locks shut while powered.
lore.supplementaries.netherite_door: An extra-sturdy door that can be locked with a Key.
lore.supplementaries.netherite_trapdoor: An extra-sturdy trapdoor that can be locked with a Key.
lore.supplementaries.dragon_banner_patte: A banner pattern that adds a dragon design at a Loom.
lore.supplementaries.awning: A cloth awning that can be tilted and placed on the top or bottom of a block. Entities bounce off it!
